headline: Granted conditional use appeals for a care facility at 16 Lincoln Street and a market garden at 104 Neal Street.
summary: The 16 Lincoln Street owner can operate a small residential care facility for up to 16 people. The 104 Neal Street owners can run a market garden on their property. Each approval lasts three years and passed 5-0.
decisions: Granted a conditional use appeal for a small residential care facility at 16 Lincoln Street for three years, 5-0.
Granted a conditional use appeal for a market garden at 104 Neal Street for three years, 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: 16 Lincoln ST, 16 Lincoln Street LLC, owner ... The Board voted 5-0 to grant the Conditional Use Appeal for a period of three years.
104 Neal St., Robert Massengale & Lily Barberich, owners ... The Board voted 5-0 to grant the Conditional Use Appeal for a period of three years.

decision_titles: Conditional use appeal for 16 Lincoln Street
Conditional use appeal for 104 Neal Street
